The dwarves of Kazordoon have set up a new mine, **Farmine**, on a distant continent (Zao). {npc:Ongulf} needs you to explore the region, bring help from Kazordoon, make peace with the cavemen, the orcs and the lizards and, in the end, win the great tournament in the Isle of Strife arena. You get the base **Warmaster** outfit, Tomes of Knowledge, 8000 experience, several potions and access to the south and centre of Zao (and Farmine grows with each mission).

After centuries, the resources beneath and around the Big Old One have become alarmingly scarce. A few decades ago, the imperial mining guild funded a project to search for and establish new mines far from Kazordoon.
Level 77 is only required for the last mission (the arena); level 110+ recommended.
For mission 9 you need **another player** who has not done the fight yet: the arena can only be entered in pairs.
Having access to {npc:Black Bert} in Thais is very useful in mission 5 for buying apology gifts (the wiki recommends having done {wiki:The Thieves Guild Quest}).
or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels} — or the spell {spell:Levitate} — to go up/down the mountain slopes
Gold for travel (e.g. 200 gold for the Steamship to Farmine, 100 gold for each extra flask of bait)

Optional: apology gifts bought from {npc:Black Bert} — {item:Flask of Crown Polisher}, {item:Soul Contract}, {item:Map to the Unknown}, {item:Almanach of Magic}, {item:Universal Tool}, {item:Baby Rotworm}
Plenty of potions and runes for the arena (mission 9)
Base outfit **Warmaster** (wardrobe in the arena's reward room)
one in the mission 7 chest and another in the mission 9 chest
Access to the southern and central parts of Zao, to the depot, tavern, bank and shops of Farmine, and to the {wiki:Magic Carpet|Magic Carpet} above Farmine
As soon as you start mission 1 (*New Land*); the north part only opens in a later mission.
Only with the {wiki:The Mage's Tower World Change} active.
Mission 3 (*Strangers in the Night*): Farmine moves to phase 2.
Opens as you do the quest's missions.
The wiki only says they become accessible after a certain mission of the quest.
Lizard teleport from the Zao Steppe to the Muggy Plains
After the **first 8 missions** (you leave through it at the end of mission 8).
It gives access to the Muggy Plains and the zones beyond them (Souleater Mountains, Nimmersatt's Breeding Ground, Temple of Equilibrium).
Mission 9 (*Mortal Combat*): {npc:Zurak}, in the Muggy Plains, takes you to the island ({key:trip}, free).
Mission 10 (*New Horizons*): {npc:Ongulf} authorises you to use the carpet at the top of the elevator, above Farmine.
Carpets are for Premium accounts only.
With the quest completed (including mission 9, *Mortal Combat*).
It is part of the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}; it takes you to the Muggy Plains, in northern Zao.
With the quest finished and at least **10 tomes** handed in to {npc:Cael} ({wiki:Tomes of Knowledge Quest}).
After mission 8 (*An Offer You Can't Refuse*).
After mission 8, {npc:Cael} accepts up to 6 {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge}; with the quest completed he accepts more.
When you receive mission 9 (*Mortal Combat*); it doesn't need to be completed.
With the quest completed (gives the base Warmaster outfit).
Learn the spell {spell:Levitate} before you start: it saves you from carrying 6 boxes/parcels to go up and down the mountain.
In mission 5, buy one gift of each kind from {npc:Black Bert} in advance if you do not want to go back and forth between Thais and the other cities.
Team up with a strong partner for mission 9 early on: the arena needs 2 players at the same time and good damage per second.
You can always check in the Quest Log which supporters (mission 5) you are still missing: the corresponding entry disappears when you convince the NPC.
You need the spell {spell:Levitate} or 3 parcels/boxes/ice cubes for this mission.

Take the dwarves' **Steamship** (for example with {npc:Gurbasch}). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and confirm with {key:yes}. The trip costs 200 gold. {npc:Gurbasch} is at the {wiki:Cormaya} Steamship harbour (from Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Cormaya for 20 gp). You can also leave from **Kazordoon**, with {npc:Brodrosch} ({key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the underground harbour of Farmine, next to {npc:Thorgrin}.

In Farmine talk to the leader, {npc:Ongulf}. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He asks whether you want the long or the short story: say {key:short} (or {key:long} and then {key:missions}). He asks you to find a passage out of the mountains.
Go **east** of Ongulf and pass through the sealed doors. Stand on the switch and use the **right lever**. This takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Mission 01: the way from the Farmine base
Find the passage through the mountains

Explore the passage **east**, going down the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or with parcels/boxes). When you step out of the mountain and reach {coord:33085,31532,7}, the message appears: *"You have found the passage through the mountains and can report about your success."*
Exit of the passage through the mountains
Mission 01: the spot where you find the passage
Go back the same way: climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or with the parcels/boxes) and go **west** to the lift, which takes you back to the Farmine base.
Passage through the mountains (exit/entrance of Farmine)
Go back to {npc:Ongulf} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to hand in the mission.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Ongulf}. He needs more miners and timber and sends you to talk to {npc:Melfar}, from the imperial mining guild, at the mines west of Kazordoon.

Travel to **Kazordoon** and walk to the {wiki:Dwarf Mines} to the **west**. Cross the two rivers. {npc:Melfar} walks on the surface by the mine, west of the warehouse and the {item:Royal Mailbox}. From Farmine, talk to {npc:Thorgrin} at the Steamship harbour: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes} (210 gp). You arrive at the underground harbour of Kazordoon, next to {npc:Brodrosch}; go up to the city, leave the mountain and walk **west**.
Melfar, in the mines west of Kazordoon
Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. Melfar gives you a {item:Flask with Beaver Bait} and marks the **3 trees** on your map.

Use the {item:Flask with Beaver Bait} on one of the marked trees (you can do them in any order). At one of them the message *"it seems someone marked it already!"* appears and 1 {creature:War Wolf} and 4 {creature:Wolf|Wolves} spawn. Kill them or run away.
The wolves spawn right around you: be ready to fight.
Use the bait on another tree. Here you annoy the family of squirrels that lived there and 4 {creature:Enraged Squirrel|Enraged Squirrels} spawn.
Mark the thieving squirrel's tree (do this one last)

At the third tree a squirrel runs off with your bait: *"its former inhabitant has stolen your bait! Get it, before it runs away!"*. If this is the **last** tree, you no longer need to chase it. If you do it before the others, kill the {creature:Thieving Squirrel} to get the bait back: it appears about 2 squares north of the tree (where King Rockey usually is).
If you have to catch it, turn invisible ({spell:Invisible}) or use a {item:Stealth Ring} so it does not run away, and attack with an area rune such as {item:GFB|Great Fireball (GFB)}.
The squirrel also turns invisible. If you lose it, you have to pay 100 gold to {npc:Melfar} for another flask of bait.
After the 3 trees, go back to {npc:Melfar} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} **before** returning to Farmine.
Go back to Farmine and say {key:mission} to {npc:Ongulf}. To return, go back to the Steamship in Kazordoon and say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes} to {npc:Brodrosch}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Ongulf}. The guards saw night visitors who fled by climbing some vines on the mountain.

Go down the mountain almost as in mission 1 (with {spell:Levitate} or parcels) and, right after you get down, head straight **north** to {coord:33025,31537,6}. Use the vines in the picture to climb up. Leave the base by the **right lever**, as in mission 1.
Vines for climbing up to the tribe
The vines you have to use to climb up

A tribe lives up there; most NPCs speak a strange language. Look for the leader, {npc:Lazaran}, who speaks very bad English. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:mission} again and {key:yes} to offer him help and peace.
Go back the same way: go down the vines ({coord:33025,31537,6}), climb the slope with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and continue to the lift, which takes you back to the base.
Go back to {npc:Ongulf} and say {key:mission}. Farmine moves on to **phase 2**: Pompan now sells normal equipment (Esrik does not trade yet and Prezil does not change).
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Ongulf}. Stone creatures have taken over mine A07 and you have to kill their leader.
Go back to the levers behind the sealed doors and this time use the **left lever**.

Head **north** through the tunnel full of {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}. At the end of the tunnel kill the boss, {creature:Shard of Corruption}. Then go back through the same tunnel to the **south**, to the levers and the base.
The tunnel of Stone Golems to the Shard of Corruption

You have to win the support of 6 people spread around the world. To each one you say {key:farmine} and then one of six approaches: {key:flatter}, {key:threaten}, {key:impress}, {key:bluff}, {key:reason} or {key:plea}. The right word can vary, and the system seems to have a random element: the same word can win the NPC over or annoy them.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Ongulf}. He explains the 6 supporters he needs and tells you that, if you ruin a negotiation, you can buy a bribe from {npc:Black Bert} in Thais.

The six NPCs are in Thais, Venore, Port Hope, Edron and Kazordoon. Leave Farmine by {npc:Thorgrin}'s Steamship: {key:kazordoon} (210 gp) or {key:cormaya} (110 gp); from Cormaya, take the boat to Edron and from there you can get boats to the other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}). To return to Farmine, use the Steamship in Kazordoon ({npc:Brodrosch}) or Cormaya ({npc:Gurbasch}) and say {key:farmine}.

For each NPC: say {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and the word from the table. Always read the answer (or check the Quest Log: the entry disappears when you succeed). If the NPC gets angry, buy the right gift from {npc:Black Bert}, come back, say {key:farmine} and {key:yes} to hand over the gift and try another word.
Even when you say the right word, the NPC sometimes refuses. In that case go back to {npc:Black Bert}, buy another gift and try again.

{npc:Black Bert}, in Thais, sells the apology gifts (having done {wiki:The Thieves Guild Quest} helps, because it lets you buy them). If you do not mind spending money, buy 1 of each before you start; otherwise, buy only when you need them.
Support of the king of Thais
Go to the **Thais** castle and talk to {npc:King Tibianus}. Greet him with {key:hail to the king}, then {key:farmine} and {key:flatter} (both the first time and after failing).
If he gets angry: with the {item:Flask of Crown Polisher} in your backpack say {key:farmine} and {key:yes} and try again.

In **Venore**, west of the depot, go up the stairs and talk to {npc:Leeland}. Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and {key:impress}. If it fails, hand over the {item:Soul Contract} ({key:farmine}, {key:yes}) and try {key:reason} or {key:flatter}.
Leeland, Venore (west of the depot, upper floor)

In **Port Hope** talk to {npc:Angus}. Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and {key:bluff} (or {key:impress}). If it fails, hand over the {item:Map to the Unknown} ({key:farmine}, {key:yes}) and try {key:impress} or {key:bluff}.

In the {wiki:Ivory Towers} talk to {npc:Wyrdin}. Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and {key:plea}, {key:bluff} or {key:flatter}. If it fails, hand over the {item:Almanach of Magic} ({key:farmine}, {key:yes}) and try {key:impress} or one of the other words.

In **Edron** talk to {npc:Telas}. **Close the door** of his house while you talk: a werebadger sometimes shows up. Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and {key:reason} or {key:flatter}. If it fails, hand over the {item:Universal Tool} ({key:farmine}, {key:yes}) and try {key:plea} (or {key:reason} again).
A werebadger may appear by surprise near Telas' house.

In **Kazordoon** talk to {npc:Humgolf}. Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and {key:flatter} or {key:threaten}. If it fails, hand over the {item:Baby Rotworm} ({key:farmine}, {key:yes}) and try one of these two words again.

With all 6 supporters, go back to {npc:Ongulf} and say {key:mission}. You gain access to Farmine's **depot** and **tavern**. To see this **phase 3** of Farmine, use the lever behind the sealed door on the right to go to the surface and come back.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Ongulf}. The orcs of the plains are planning to attack and you have to talk to their leader.

Go to the middle of the **Zao** steppe, to the north-east area of an orc camp (there are only weak orcs). Talk to {npc:Curos}: say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:prove} and {key:test}. The test is to survive 2 minutes against a {creature:Mooh'Tah Master}. To get there, leave the base by the **right lever**, go down the mountain to the **east** as far as the passage ({coord:33085,31532,7}) and continue across the steppe.
Curos, orc camp on the Zao steppe
Passage through the mountains (exit/entrance of Farmine)

The entrance (a teleport) is at the top of some stairs, near Curos, to the **south-west**. Enter when you are ready. In the small arena you can simply run around or block for the 2 minutes. Afterwards you are teleported to a small spot below/outside the arena.
Teleport to the Mooh'Tah Master arena
Avoid the {creature:Mooh'Tah Master}'s energy beam: always stay **diagonal** to him.
Go back to {npc:Curos} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He promises to spare the dwarves' base.

Say {key:mission} to {npc:Ongulf}. You gain access to Farmine's **bank**. To return to Farmine, go back to the passage through the mountains ({coord:33085,31532,7}), climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and go **west** to the lift, which takes you back to the base.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Ongulf}. Now you have to contact the lizards, the true lords of Zao, in the mountains to the north.

Go to the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks} and find a rope spot. Go up with the {item:Rope} and follow the path around the mountain (there is only one path). The Dragonblaze Peaks are **north** of the Zao steppe: leave Farmine through the mission 1 passage and head north.
Rope hole in the Dragonblaze Peaks

You eventually go down and find {wiki:High Class Lizards} ({creature:Lizard High Guard}, {creature:Lizard Legionnaire}, {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest}...). Follow the path around (see map) and go down some stairs to another floor with more lizards until you reach a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door}.
Map of the path through the lizard area to the quest door
There is more than one quest door in this area, but you can only open one: that is the right one.
In the room **west** of the quest door there is a {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} with a {item:Tome of Knowledge}. Open it before continuing.
Go through the quest door and enter the room behind it: you are teleported to a small **prison**.
8. Mission 08: An Offer You Can't Refuse
Find the note under the bed

In the **north-west** corner of the prison there is a note hidden under a bed ({item:Strange Grass Mat}); you can see the tip sticking out. Use the bed to get the {item:The Secret Door (Book)|note} and read it: it says there is a way out to the north.
The prison: bed with the note and the dragon decoration on the north wall
Click the {item:Dragon Decoration} in the middle of the **north** wall. You appear on the other side.

Go **north** and talk to {npc:Ztiss}, the leader of the lizards. Say {key:hi}, {key:guezt}, {key:offer}, {key:work}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again to drink the poison that seals the deal (you have to take part in the tournament).

Leave through the teleport in the top-left corner. You appear next to a pair of teleports in the north of the Zao steppe, which lead to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}. You do not have to fight in the arena right away: you can come back later. To return to Farmine, go back to the passage through the mountains ({coord:33085,31532,7}), climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and go **west** to the lift, which takes you back to the base.
Access to the Farmine shops; {npc:Cael} (just north of Ongulf) now accepts 6 {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge}.

You need level 77 and a partner who has not done the fight yet: only 2 players can enter at the same time. Recommended combinations: Knight + Druid (the best), Knight + Sorcerer, Knight + Paladin, 2 Paladins or 2 Sorcerers.

Enter the teleport in the north of the Zao steppe to reach the {wiki:Muggy Plains}. Go a little to the **north-east** along the coast to {npc:Zurak}'s boat and ask him for passage to the {wiki:Isle of Strife} (Chazorai). Say {key:hi}, {key:trip} and {key:yes} (the trip is free). You arrive at the island's dock, where Zurak is as well.
Zurak's boat to the Isle of Strife
Zurak at the Isle of Strife dock

On the island follow the path up several flights of stairs, fighting many {wiki:High Class Lizards} (including the annoying {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest|Lizard Dragon Priests} and even {creature:Draken Warmaster|Draken Warmasters}), to the arena entrance at the top of the mountain.
Bring friends to help you reach the arena without using up your supplies for the fight, or bring extra potions.
Pick up the second Tome of Knowledge
There is a {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} to the **left** of the stairs you go down to the arena NPC. **Do not forget** to pick up the {item:Tome of Knowledge} from this chest.
Go **east** and talk to {npc:Chrak}: say {key:hi}, {key:battle} and {key:yes}. You can say {key:rulez} to hear the rules. Your partner has to do the same.

With Knight + Druid, the Druid uses {spell:Exura Sio} on the Knight and attacks with {item:Sudden Death} and {item:Icicle}, while the Knight uses {spell:Challenge} non-stop. The mage should bring about 180 charges of Sudden Death and 160 {item:Great Mana Potion|Great Mana Potions}. Two Knights can team up with {spell:Exori Gran}, but they use up many {item:Great Health Potion|Great Health Potions} and {item:Mana Potion|Mana Potions}. Two Sorcerers can do it with {spell:Hell's Core} and Sudden Death while recovering mana (it is the fastest method but also the most dangerous, because nobody can take the damage).
A level 100 Knight can block the fight, as long as the shooter kills the bosses in time. The last bosses change target often, so it is best to be able to take 1200 damage without dying.

The bosses appear in **waves of 2**. Each new wave appears **90 seconds** after the previous one, **even if there are still bosses alive**. Sometimes they spawn off-screen: time the 90 seconds and pull them to you if needed.
Neutral to all damage; Baron Brute is strong against fire.
Immune to earth, weak to fire (110%), neutral to the rest.
Both immune to ice and fire; Incineron is strong against energy. Neutral to the rest.
Dreadwing immune to death and earth; Doomhowl strong against physical. Neutral to the rest.
Haunter strong against death (90%). Neutral to the rest.
Rocko: immune to death and earth; takes fire 70%, energy 75%, ice 80%, physical 85%, holy 90%. Tremorak: immune to earth, weak to fire; takes energy 15%, holy 50%, physical 50%, death 65%, ice 80%.
Strong against everything: fire 50%; earth, energy, ice, holy and death 70%; physical 90%.
The biggest danger is lack of damage: if you take too long, you end up with 3 or 4 bosses on top of you at once, which is very risky at any level.

When you kill {creature:Tirecz}, you are teleported to the reward room and the message *"You have won! As new champion take the ancient armor as reward before you leave."* appears. **Do not forget** to use the wardrobe to receive the outfit before you leave.
Go back to {npc:Chrak} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He removes the poison from you.
If you do not report to Chrak, you cannot finish the quest with {npc:Ongulf}.

Go down the mountain the same way (stairs and lizards) to the dock and talk to {npc:Zurak} to return to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}. From there enter the old lizard teleport to go back to the Zao steppe. To return to Farmine, go back to the passage through the mountains ({coord:33085,31532,7}), climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and go **west** to the lift, which takes you back to the base.
Zurak's boat in the Muggy Plains
Passage through the mountains (exit/entrance of Farmine)

Go back to **Farmine** and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to {npc:Ongulf}. You receive **8000 experience points** and permission to use the {wiki:Magic Carpet|Magic Carpet} at the top of the lift, on the mountain above Farmine. {npc:Cael} now accepts more {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge}.
8000 experience and access to the Magic Carpet
Farmine evolves as you progress: phase 2 after mission 3 (Pompan sells equipment), depot and tavern after mission 5, bank after mission 6 and shops after mission 8.
The {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge} are handed in to {npc:Cael}, just north of {npc:Ongulf}.
The wiki numbers the mission 2 trees differently in different places; the important thing is to leave the thieving squirrel's tree for last.
